notes.title: Upcoming update and DLC
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Now preparing an update to the game that will slightly change its state.
What do you mean by state change? The game will no longer have the levels that were there, but will now have chapters as separate levels with their own unique mechanics and locations. With the new update will come a new chapter as well as new DLC!



Thanks for understanding.

notes.title: New Year's update 🎄
notes.notes:
New Year's update for Uncle's Basement! 🎄

What's New:


 Decorations: New Year's decorations have been added to the environment to create a festive atmosphere.
 Updated UI: The improved UI has become more comfortable and pleasant to use.
 Gameplay improvements: We fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
The first major update after the release of the game! During this time we have prepared a lot of new content and new items. After studying the feedback from testers and players, as well as analyzing the game, we came to the decision that we need to change and improve a lot of things. 

Meet Uncle's Basement - 1.1!

Uncle's Basement 1.1

- Expansion of locations

 Added Laboratory
 Added Monolith Room
 Weapon room added
 Added damaged hotel location
.
- New escape routes

 Monolith Exit Passage

- New items

 Walkie-talkie
 Homemade bomb
 Computer
 Monolith
 Security cameras

- Interface Enhancements

 New main menu
 New pause menu

- Fixed minor bugs
- New achievements added

notes.notes:
Minor UI improvements

 Improved button order in pause menu.
 Added training.
 Added mouse sensitivity adjustment.
 Changed music in the main menu.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
In version 1.0.1 we have added, fixed and improved the game:

 Added the ability to use cheats, for fun of course.
In this version you can become invincible.
You can also shorten your enemies, literally. They will become shorter and fatter (it looks funny).

 Improved the sound of the gramophone, now you can enjoy the music properly.

 Fixed a bug with passing through an enemy.
